parameters.content:
Subscription Reconciliation Agent v1.0.0

Reconciles GuardianHub entitlements with Stripe using Stripe as the payment source of truth. Verifies webhook signatures, never duplicates entitlement changes, flags mismatches for review and applies configured grace periods safely.

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;if(!s)throw new Error('N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET not configured');const body=$json.body||'';const sig=String($json.headers['x-gh-signature']||'').toLowerCase();const computed=crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(body)).digest('hex');if(sig!==computed)throw new Error('Invalid signature');const ts=parseInt($json.headers['x-gh-timestamp']||'0',10);if(!ts||Math.abs(Date.now()-ts)>300000)throw new Error('Expired timestamp');return[{json:{body,headers:$json.headers,timestamp:String(ts),nonce:$json.headers['x-gh-nonce']||'',correlation_id:$json.headers['x-gh-correlation-id']||''}}];

const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET||$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;const b=$json.body||'';const cb={run_id:b.run_id||'',agent_key:b.agent_key,company_id:b.company_id,event_type:b.event_type,status:'succeeded',result:{agent:'subscription-reconciliation',message:'Subscription reconciliation processed',processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}};const sig=s?crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(cb)).digest('hex'):'';return[{json:{callback:cb,signature:sig,timestamp:$json.timestamp,nonce:$json.nonce,correlation_id:$json.correlation_id}}];
